An '''Ithorian''' lived during the [[Imperial Era]]. They worked as a [[technician]], and were captured by the [[Galactic Empire]] to work on a [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station|secret project]].<ref name="Name of the Rebellion" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The [[Ithorian]] is voiced by [[Jennifer Hale]], who voiced [[Aayla Secura]] in ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]''.
